info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Payments Payments Charge-v5-spec
info.description: The Payments Charge API facilitates the bulk processing of payment transactions, allowing businesses to efficiently manage multiple payment charges in a single request. This API is designed for payment processors and financial service providers seeking to streamline their operations by automating the charge process for various payment methods. Typical use cases include online retailers and subscription services looking to handle large volumes of payment transactions simultaneously. By integrating this API, developers can enhance their payment processing capabilities and improve transaction efficiency.
